programme: Double Minor Program in Chemical Process Design

units.title: Introduction to Chemical Engineering
units.topics: Role and scope of chemical engineering, Chemical process industries and their applications, Batch and continuous processes, Basic process terminology and variables, Physical and chemical processes

units.title: Chemical Process Flow
units.topics: Raw materials, products and by-products, Unit operations and unit processes, Block Flow Diagram (BFD) Process Flow Diagram (PFD), Basic process streams and recycle systems

units.title: Basic Process Operations
units.topics: Material handling and storage, Fluid flow and pumping, Heat transfer and heat exchangers, Separation processes, Reaction processes

units.title: Major Process Equipment
units.topics: Reactors, Distillation and absorption columns, Heat exchangers, Pumps and compressors, Storage tanks and pressure vessels, Basic equipment selection

units.title: Process Design Perspectives
units.topics: Introduction to process design methodology, Process safety fundamentals, Energy and resource efficiency Environmental considerations, Introduction to sustainable chemical process design, Industrial case studies

subjects.title: Introduction to Chemical Process Engineering Laboratory
Process Calculations and Fluid Flow Fundamentals

units.title: Fundamentals of Chemical Process Calculations
units.topics: Units and dimensions, Mole concept and molecular weight, Composition of solids, liquids and gases, Stoichiometric calculations

units.title: Material Balance Calculations
units.topics: Overall and component material balances, material balances with recycle, bypass and purge, Balances involving chemical reactions, conversion, yield and selectivity, simple process flow calculations

units.title: Energy Balance and Process Calculations
units.topics: Basic concepts of energy balance, Sensible and latent heat, Heat capacity and enthalpy, Energy balance for simple processes, Combined material and energy balance

units.title: Fundamentals of Fluid Flow
units.topics: Properties of fluids, fluid pressure and fluid statics, continuity equation, Bernoulli’s equation, laminar and turbulent flow, Reynolds number

units.title: Fluid Flow Equipment and Measurement
units.topics: Flow through pipes and pressure drop, friction factor and pipe fittings, valves and basic piping systems Pumps and their basic operation, flow measurement: orifice meter, venturimeter and rotameter

subjects.title: Process Calculations and Fluid Flow Fundamentals Laboratory

units.title: Fundamentals of Heat Transfer
units.topics: Basic concepts of heat transfer, Modes of heat transfer: conduction, convection and radiation , Fourier’s law of conduction, Steady-state heat conduction, Basic heat transfer calculations

units.title: Convective Heat Transfer
units.topics: Natural and forced convection, newton’s law of cooling, boundary layer concept, basic dimensionless numbers: Reynolds, Prandtl and Nusselt numbers, applications of convection heat transfer

units.title: Heat Transfer Equipment
units.topics: Heat exchangers and their classification, double-pipe and shell-and-tube heat exchangers, overall heat-transfer coefficient, Log Mean Temperature Difference (LMTD), Basic heat exchanger calculations

units.title: Fundamentals of Mass Transfer
units.topics: Introduction to mass transfer, Molecular and convective mass transfer, Fick’s law of diffusion , Concentration and mass-transfer driving forces, Mass-transfer coefficients

units.title: Basic Mass Transfer Operations
units.topics: Gas absorption and stripping, Distillation fundamentals , Liquid–liquid extraction , Drying fundamentals , Basic applications of mass transfer in chemical industries

subjects.title: Heat and Mass Transfer Fundamentals Laboratory

units.title: Basic Thermodynamics
units.topics: Fundamental concepts and laws of thermodynamics, properties of pure substances, work and heat interactions, first and second laws of thermodynamics, entropy and thermodynamic processes

units.title: Phase and Chemical Equilibrium
units.topics: Phase equilibrium and phase rule, vapor–liquid equilibrium, fugacity and activity, chemical equilibrium, equilibrium constant and effect of temperature and pressure

units.title: Fundamentals of Chemical Reaction Engineering
units.topics: Introduction to chemical reactions, Reaction rate and rate laws, Order and molecularity of reactions, Temperat ure dependence of reaction rate, Arrhenius equation and activation energy

units.title: Reactor Design and Analysis
units.topics: Ideal batch reactor, continuous stirred-tank reactor (CSTR), Plug-flow reactor (PFR), Reactor sizing and conversion, Comparison of ideal reactor performance

units.title: Multiple Reactions and Applications
units.topics: Series and parallel reactions, selectivity and yield, reversible reactions, catalytic and non-catalytic reactions, basic industrial applications of reaction engineering
